create_streaming_mean_estimator: create a StreamingMean instance with a specified shape and dtype to estimate tensor means
submit_tensor_to_streaming_mean: submit a single or batch tensor to the StreamingMean to refine the running mean estimate
get_streaming_mean_value: get the current streaming mean value by accessing the value property of StreamingMean
get_streaming_mean_count: get the number of submitted samples by accessing the count property of StreamingMean
clear_and_reset_streaming_mean: clear the StreamingMean statistics and return the final mean estimate before resetting
